query: what is the hotel cost in paros

use_cases.use_case_title: View hotel search results and prices for Paros for given dates and occupancy
use_cases.goal: Verify that a user can see available properties in Paros with correct pricing information for the selected dates and occupancy.
preconditions: User can access the Booking.com website.
Hotel Search feature is available and functional.
Search index contains properties for Paros with availability and prices.
steps: In the search form, enter destination as "Paros".
Select check-in date as Sat, Dec 27 and check-out date as Sat, Jan 3.
Set occupancy to 2 adults, 0 children, 1 room.
Ensure currency is set to INR.
On the search results page, observe the total number of properties found for Paros.
Scroll to the listed properties and note the displayed prices and any taxes/fees for each property.
Verify that properties such as "Porto Bello di Paros", "Perivoli Luxury Homes, Paros", and "JUST BLUE with amazing Sea Views" show prices consistent with the UI.
expected_results: Search results page for Paros is displayed with a message like "Paros: 180 properties found".
A notice is shown that 87% of places to stay are unavailable for the selected dates.
Each listed property shows a price in INR and clearly indicates any additional taxes and fees.
For "Porto Bello di Paros", a discounted price of ₹ 42,948 plus ₹ 366 taxes and fees is displayed for the selected dates.
For "Perivoli Luxury Homes, Paros", a discounted price of ₹ 76,801 plus ₹ 366 taxes and fees is displayed for "1 week, 2 adults".
For "JUST BLUE with amazing Sea Views", a discounted price of ₹ 56,302 plus ₹ 14,836 taxes and fees is displayed for "1 week, 2 adults".
The user can infer the approximate hotel cost in Paros for the selected dates from the displayed prices.
negative_cases: Search results fail to load or show an error instead of the Paros properties list.
Prices are missing, displayed in a different currency than INR, or taxes and fees are not shown.
The number of properties found does not match the displayed list (e.g., shows 180 properties found but no items are listed).
Properties known from the context (e.g., "Porto Bello di Paros") do not appear despite being expected for the given dates.
boundary_cases: Search when almost all properties are unavailable (e.g., 87% unavailable) and verify that remaining available properties still show correct prices.
Search with the same dates but different occupancy (e.g., 1 adult or more rooms) and verify that prices update accordingly, if data is available.
Search with dates adjacent to the given range (e.g., one day earlier or later) to verify that availability and prices change appropriately, if data is available.

use_cases.use_case_title: Filter Paros hotel search results by budget per night
use_cases.goal: Verify that the user can filter Paros properties by budget per night and still see correct prices for the filtered results.
preconditions: User is on the Paros search results page with results already loaded.
Filter panel with "Your budget (per night)" is visible.
steps: From the Paros search results page, locate the "Filter by" section.
Identify the "Your budget (per night)" filter showing the range "₹ 3,000 – ₹ 90,000+".
Apply a budget filter that includes the prices of properties like "Porto Bello di Paros" and "JUST BLUE with amazing Sea Views" (within the visible range).
Observe the updated list of properties after the budget filter is applied.
Check that the displayed prices for the filtered properties remain consistent with their original values and still show taxes and fees.
expected_results: The budget filter "₹ 3,000 – ₹ 90,000+" is available and can be selected.
After applying the budget filter, the list of properties is updated without errors.
Only properties whose prices fall within the selected budget range are displayed.
Prices for properties such as "Porto Bello di Paros" and "JUST BLUE with amazing Sea Views" remain correctly displayed in INR with separate taxes and fees lines.
The user can still determine the approximate hotel cost in Paros within the chosen budget range.
negative_cases: Applying the budget filter results in an error or blank page.
Properties outside the selected budget range are still shown.
Prices disappear or are shown without taxes and fees after applying the filter.
Currency changes unexpectedly when the budget filter is applied.
boundary_cases: Apply the lowest possible budget range (e.g., starting at ₹ 3,000) and verify that only the cheapest properties are shown, if any.
Apply the highest budget range (e.g., ₹ 90,000+) and verify that high-priced properties are shown, if any.
Apply a budget filter that results in zero matching properties and verify that an appropriate "no results" message is displayed.

assumptions: The prices shown in the screenshots (e.g., ₹ 42,948 + ₹ 366 taxes and fees for Porto Bello di Paros) are final for the specified dates and occupancy.
The currency is set to INR for the user session.
The phrase "1 week, 2 adults" corresponds exactly to the selected date range Sat, Dec 27 — Sat, Jan 3.
missing_info: Exact per-night breakdown of the total prices for each property is not provided.
Behavior when changing currency from INR to another currency is not described.
Exact interaction details for the budget slider or budget filter options (e.g., discrete buckets vs free-range slider) are not specified.
